package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

func TestOnboardingAdmissionUsesDistinctOperationKeysAndStrictFullReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	handoffID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	executionID := "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	admissionID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	reserveKey := domain.OnboardingAdmissionOperationKey(executionID, "reserve", 0)
	renewKey := domain.OnboardingAdmissionOperationKey(executionID, "renew", 1)
	var keys []string
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		keys = append(keys, r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key"))
		body := map[string]any{"schema": "student-onboarding-path-admission.v1", "admission_id": admissionID, "student_id": studentID, "handoff_id": handoffID, "execution_id": executionID, "state_ref": map[string]any{"kind": "accepted_draft", "version": 1}, "goal": map[string]any{"code": "programming.foundation", "version": "v1", "graph_version": "g"}, "status": "RESERVED", "fence": 2, "expires_at": time.Now().UTC().Add(time.Minute), "replayed": r.URL.Path != "/internal/students/"+studentID+"/onboarding-path-admissions"}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		if body["replayed"].(bool) {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		} else {
			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
		}
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(body)
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, WriteToken: "planner", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	handoff := domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{HandoffID: handoffID, StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", RequestHash: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", StateRef: domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, DialogID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", TeacherJobID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", Goal: domain.LearningReadinessGoal{Code: "programming.foundation", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "g"}, ReadinessObservedAt: time.Now().UTC(), CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
	admission, err := client.ReserveOnboardingPathExecution(context.Background(), handoff, executionID, reserveKey)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err = client.RenewOnboardingPathExecution(context.Background(), handoff, admission.AdmissionID, 1, executionID, renewKey); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(keys) != 2 || keys[0] != reserveKey || keys[1] != renewKey || keys[0] == keys[1] {
		t.Fatalf("operation keys=%#v", keys)
	}
}

func TestOnboardingAdmissionRejectsPartialReceipt(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"admission_id": "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444", "fence": 1, "status": "RESERVED"})
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := Client{BaseURL: server.URL, WriteToken: "planner", HTTPClient: server.Client()}
	handoff := domain.OnboardingPlanHandoffRecord{HandoffID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", StudentID: studentID, IdempotencyKey: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555", RequestHash: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", StateRef: domain.StudentReadinessStateRef{Kind: domain.StudentReadinessStateDraft, Version: 1}, DialogID: "66666666-6666-4666-8666-666666666666", TeacherJobID: "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777", Goal: domain.LearningReadinessGoal{Code: "programming.foundation", Version: "v1", GraphVersion: "g"}, ReadinessObservedAt: time.Now().UTC(), CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
	if _, err := client.ReserveOnboardingPathExecution(context.Background(), handoff, "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", domain.OnboardingAdmissionOperationKey("33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", "reserve", 0)); err != domain.ErrValidation {
		t.Fatalf("error=%v", err)
	}
}
